1432-1556-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
1432-1556-2645-3430.description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding twelve {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Scorched Ruins
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2137-4642-6968.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-4642-6968.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

4613-4687-6479.easyPrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Rainveil Rejuvenator has a +1/+1 counter on it.

654-880-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-7892.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land that entered.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3368-7683.notablePrerequisites: You have another instant or sorcery card in hand with the mana to cast it and applicable target(s) if needed.
3368-7683.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Reiterate's storm ability triggers, creating at least one copy of Reiterate targeting the original Reiterate.
Resolve a copy of Reiterate, copying Reiterate targeting the original Reiterate.
Repeat step 4.

2556-3115-3557.description:
Cast Cyclonic Rift for its overload cost by paying {6}{U}, returning all nonland permanents you don't control to their owners' hands.
Deal combat damage using Brago, triggering its ability, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Cyclonic Rift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

3197-4017-6830-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-4017-6830-7810.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4694-7652.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tom, Bert, and William.
When Tom, Bert, and William die, they trigger, returning them from your graveyard to the battlefield as a noncreature artifact.
Because Tom, Bert, and William enter as a noncreature artifact, March of the Machines will then cause Tom, Bert, and William to be a 5/5 artifact creature.
Repeat.

4377-5531-7638.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
4377-5531-7638.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Blink Lumra using The Mind Stone.
When Lumra enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7236.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Towering Titan.
When Towering Titan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

527-1409-1879.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

1069-1796-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
1069-1796-7070.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The equip ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0}
Repeat.

1796-3140-7070.description:
Activate Soltari Guerrillas by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Soltari Guerrillas.
The Soltari Guerrillas ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Soltari Guerrillas from exile by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat.

5641-6719-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-6719-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-6259-6769.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-5078-6259-6769.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2034-2279-5058.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2308-2811.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-2811.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger from step 3, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature with MV=1 and Creates Creature Token(s) on Death

2178-5147-6542--110.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with mana value 0.
2178-5147-6542--110.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 0.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Sidisi trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with two or more charge counters on it

198-2816-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
198-2816-3918.notes: You can start the combo with fewer charge counters on Trazyn if you provide some mana to start.

1848-6464.description:
Declare Lord Xander as an attacker, triggering its second ability, causing a player to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Keening Stone by paying {5} and tapping it, causing the player to mill cards equal to the number of cards in their graveyard, thus milling the rest of their library.

1170-2196-2701-4125.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1170-2196-2701-4125.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Frantic Search from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat.

791-3693-5426-6257.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3693-5426-6257.description:
Cast Insult by paying {2}{R}, doubling the damage sources you control would deal this turn.
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3.

2557-4559-5686.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 11.
2557-4559-5686.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating two Blood tokens.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Bloods, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3129-5014-5742-5743.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2099-3908-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Spark Double on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
2099-3908-5365.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Spark Double's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Spark Double.
Spark Double's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.
2099-3908-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

710-772-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding {C}{C}.
When Danitha dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

1479-4677-5233.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4677-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Zendikar's Roil, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2084-3280.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2084-3280.description:
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

3073-3398-4076.notablePrerequisites:
You have a full party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos and Hellkite Charger.
3073-3398-4076.description:
Declare Burakos and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering their abilities twice.
Resolve both Burakos triggers, creating eight Treasure artifact tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 8 life.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the first Hellkite Charger trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2397-2788-3634-4872.notablePrerequisites: You haven't cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
2397-2788-3634-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Double Vision triggers, copying Time Warp.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Time Warp to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3188-4186-4384.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-4186-4384.description:
Gain life.
Treebeard's second ability triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

803-1413-2534.notablePrerequisites:
Thraben Doomsayer does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1413-2534.description:
Activate Thraben Doomsayer by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token.
When the Human enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Arcane Adaptation, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Thraben Doomsayer.
Repeat.

948-2060-2433-3129-3545.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
948-2060-2433-3129-3545.description:
Activate Ooze Flux by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Rosie Cotton of South Lane triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler and any other creature you control due to Primal Vigor.
When the Oozes enters the battlefield, Sigil Captain triggers twice, putting four +1/+1 counters on each of them due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

643-2290-4384.notablePrerequisites: Spike Feeder has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
643-2290-4384.description:
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain two life.
Treebeard triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Repeat.
Once Spike Feeder has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may target any other creature with Treebeard's ability.

2-1636-4938.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures.
2-1636-4938.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by tapping four creatures you control.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

398-3417.notablePrerequisites:
Ill-Tempered Loner can be transformed.
You have a way to deal damage to Ill-Tempered Loner.
398-3417.description:
Cast Angelfire Ignition by paying {1}{R}{W}, giving Ill-Tempered Loner lifelink and indestructible until end of turn.
Deal damage to Ill-Tempered Loner.
Ill-Tempered Loner triggers, dealing 2 damage to itself and causing you to gain two life.
Repeat step 3.

643-4050-4338.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Maskwood Nexus, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

109-1235-1718-4863.description:
Cast Twinflame with Strive by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting Revolutionist and Catalyst Elemental.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying {R}{R}, creating a copy of Twinflame.
Resolve the Twinflame copy, creating a token copy of Revolutionist and Catalyst Elemental.
Revolutionist enters the battlefield triggers, returning Fork from your graveyard to hand.
Holding priority, activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

738-3652-4659-4733.description:
Sacrifice Ornithopter to Krark-Clan Ironworks, adding {C}{C}.
Dictate of Erebos triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Ornithopter to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
